title: More current in a solenoid
hook: Change current magnitude and predict interior magnetic-field magnitude.
misconception: interior magnetic-field magnitude stays fixed when current magnitude doubles.
objective: Apply B = μ₀nI to compare interior magnetic-field magnitude when current magnitude changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With an ideal long solenoid with fixed turn density, B = μ₀nI. When current magnitude doubles, interior magnetic-field magnitude becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model B = μ₀nI; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider an ideal long solenoid with fixed turn density, with a nonzero initial result. If current magnitude triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on interior magnetic-field magnitude?
recall.why: Apply B = μ₀nI under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
